options.name: Linked pockets
options.subtitle: A sequence with thicker thresholds
story: The south arrival remains outside first.
A porch leads into a shared interior,
then small rooms nest along its edge.
risk: Risk: a corridor with rooms attached.
Test each shared pocket as a place to stay,
not just a route through the building.

options.name: Pocket court
options.subtitle: Outside reappears inside the nest
story: Enter through the same south porch.
The shared interior surrounds a small
open court; rooms form its outer edge.
risk: Risk: the court consumes scarce floor area.
The earlier large court is reduced to a
small test pocket, not two separate wings.
options.operation: Nest an outdoor pocket inside shared space.

options.name: Vertical commons
options.subtitle: The threshold continues upstairs
story: The south porch leads to a compact hall.
Shared landings extend the arrival upward;
contained rooms sit beside these landings.
risk: Risk: the public life moves upstairs.
Keep a useful shared ground floor and
reach every landing by lift as well as stair.
options.operation: Repeat the layers on successive landings.

notes: Outer projected envelope includes entry porch and upper overlaps.
4 m inset on all boundaries is a study, not statutory approval.
Open ground includes routes and possible vehicle works; not all green or public.
Ramp is a requirement, not a fitted or graded design.
B1 extent, area counting and four-floor interpretation require confirmation.
Spatial conditions, not program zoning. No final option selected.
